system.description:
Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You settle into the animal’s movement until your hands and its breathing find a rhythm.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Guile
Target / range / shape
One willing mount you are riding; one consequential noncombat obstacle.
Duration
For this obstacle.
Equipment / acquisition
A willing mount; none granted.
Limits
Ordinary activities remain available without this card. Roll only when uncertainty has consequences.
Type
Skill / Utility

Describe how you guide the mount. The DA states the obstacle’s progress target before the roll. Use only routes the mount can physically negotiate. This card grants neither a mount nor extra combat actions.

Weak
1 progress; keep one held item secure.
Standard
2 progress; keep that item secure and identify a nearby place to steady the mount.
Strong
3 progress; gain both benefits and give one following rider 1 Boon to their next roll at this obstacle.
